// dir: x
// want: clean
// with: core
package x

import "github.com/0b1-PulsarTech/pulsarules_codex/internal/analyzer/core"

func limit[Item any](params core.ParamSet, _ Item) int { return params.Int("max_lines", 0) }

func run(ctx core.AnalysisContext) {
	_ = limit(ctx.Params("file-size"), "unused")
}
